fix: Write the process as the absence of the parts that carry it: whole plant PO:0000003 has part some asexual propagule (gemma, brood body, rhizoidal tuber), negated (absent). In OWL: not (has_part some propagule). RDF keeps the source wording.

'Not opening widely' only says how far the flower opens, and vaguely. PATO 'opened'/'closed' do not fit, and a term for it would be doubtful.
